_about: Screening of Replay candidates against eval/SCORING.md R3 (S1-S8).
pre_registration: eval/SCORING.md, section Phase 3 Replay (commit 77bbc85), with changelog items 1-8 (wave 2 and coverage: commit a37fc10)
screened: 2026-10-27 by Claude (AI) from registry records; every decision is to be checked by the user. S2 values need extraction from the primary paper and a second-person check; S8 needs Data Support Gate counts.
operational_rules: Stage A (search hits only, registry fields): S1 fails if the design model is not parallel, factorial or crossover; S3 fails if the minimum age is under 18 or not given; S4 fails if no intervention is a drug, biological, procedure, dietary supplement or combination product; S2 fails if there is no linked result publication, no posted primary analysis with a CI and no PubMed RCT article carrying the NCT number.
Stage B: the remaining search hits, the parity trials and the named candidates, judged on S1-S7 from the registry record. Interventions never used in US practice (investigational agents) fail S4.
conditional: passes once the named unmapped MIMIC item is mapped (changelog item 7). uncertain: one criterion needs a check (named in 'failed').

B1 (search hits not judged in the first screening, changelog item 9): kept for stage B only if the first primary outcome is death or a structured in-hospital event (eval/replay_screen.py, outcome_rule_b1).
